title: Cipher Rekeying via Closures
description: Unifies cipher values, cipher maps, and cipher data structures under a single SICP-style closure-over-a-secret abstraction. Introduces the rekeying functor as a natural transformation between cipher spaces with different secrets, implemented as a cipher map (constructed by the trusted machine, applied by the untrusted machine). Proves an information-theoretic chain bound H(X | view) >= H(X) - log_2(n+1) for n-step rekeying chains, with no reliance on computational hardness assumptions. Frames the resulting bounded composition depth as a sub-Turing security feature: chain length is the explicit expressivity budget; log_2(n+1) is the explicit confidentiality cost.
